children: Yorkville Advisors, together with Islet Management, disclosed a 6.4% stake in OraSure Technologies, Inc. They filed a Schedule 13D on Sep. 17, 2026, after accumulating 4.41 million shares. The move signals plans to influence strategy and board composition, including potential director nominations.

Yorkville Advisors and Islet formed a group on Sept. 11, 2026 to "work together to enhance stockholder value" at OraSure. They plan to engage with the board and management on strategy and capital allocation, and they are considering "the potential nomination of individuals to the Board" at the 2027 annual meeting.

The group agreed to coordinate SEC filings and communications and to pre-clear certain trades. They may buy more shares, sell shares, or talk with other shareholders and potential acquirers as they evaluate options to boost performance.

Yorkville Advisors is an investment firm known for structured financing and event-driven strategies, often using PIPEs and convertible securities. Its affiliate, YA II PN, Ltd., directly holds 5.7% of OraSure’s shares, while Islet Management holds about 0.7%. Mark Angelo leads the Yorkville platform and oversees vehicles that invest in public equities and hybrid instruments.
